english.title: Cause use of a motor vehicle showing a light other than red to the rear
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was fitted with a lamp capable of showing a light to the rear other than a red light.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(2) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to the misuse of optional coloured lamps/reflectors/beacons other than red showing to the rear of the vehicle.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H3093, H2593, H2594, H3097 H3098 and H3099 in relation to optional flashing lamps or beacons.
(iii) See regulation 11(2)(a) to (w) for exceptions to this offence. e.g. amber beacons are permitted on breakdown and maintenance vehicles and green beacons are permitted on medical practitioner vehicles.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(v) See also offence wordings: H273 and H300.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) which was fitted with a lamp capable of showing a light to the rear other than a red light.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
